documents.text:
# Transport
An automobile is a wheeled road vehicle used to carry passengers. Its engine can run on petrol or an electric battery.

documents.name: moon.md

# Fictional atlas
Car is the name of a fictional moon in this invented atlas. It has no connection to terrestrial transportation.

documents.name: leave-current.md
documents.text:
# Leave policy effective 2026
Employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave. Unused days cannot be carried forward. This policy replaces the 2025 policy.

documents.name: leave-old.md
documents.text:
# Superseded leave policy, 2025
Employees received 20 days of paid annual leave. This policy is historical and is superseded by the 2026 policy.

documents.name: support.md
documents.text:
# Support handbook
Error E-417 indicates an expired session token. Sign in again to obtain a new token. Reinstalling the application does not fix E-417.

documents.name: network.md
documents.text:
# Network handbook
Error E-471 indicates a failed network connection. Check DNS and firewall rules. This is a different error from E-417.

documents.name: backup.md
documents.text:
# Recovery procedure
Stop the service before making a backup of the database and artifacts. Restore into an empty directory. Start the service and verify a saved review resumes.

documents.name: study.md
documents.text:
# Trial report
The trial enrolled 20 adults. It measured blood pressure after 12 months. It did not measure survival or demonstrate a mortality benefit.

documents.name: advert.md
documents.text:
# Unverified advertisement
An advertisement claims a mortality benefit for the trial intervention. It provides no survival measurements and conflicts with the trial's stated outcomes.

documents.name: refund.md
documents.text:
# Refund policy
Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
